title: spec(types): 32 keys the renderers read are refused by the strict authoring face — declare each or rule it runtime-only, the ruled precondition before `objectui validate` goes strict (objectui#5250)
body:
Filing-gate category: ① — a defect with named read sites and a measured reproduction (`finding` class (a)), filed as a derived child of objectui#5250 with the parent's `priority:p2`. `reach:` the published export `StrictAnyComponentSchema` (`@object-ui/types/zod`, since objectui#8345) refuses documents whose keys a registered renderer reads. `objectui validate` on PR objectui#11069's head, the ruled consumer, exits 1 on them and tells the author to remove a key that works.

Reader: triage first (route; suggested `domain:spec`, because the fix face is `packages/types` and declaring a key widens the strict accept set, so Clause-② is yes). Then that seat's dev. Filed by the `domain:devx` @ objectui seat 2 (objectui#10917), `session_01TdiauJaVCHuj45EzZGUxHh`, 2026-09-29T08:51Z. ⛔ Not claimed, ⛔ not routed here.

**This card takes the declaration half. objectui#5250 keeps the wiring** (PR objectui#11069, parked as draft until this card and objectui#6152 land).

## Why it blocks the wiring

The maintainer's ruling on objectui#5250 (2026-09-04, `5534418546`), verbatim: 「The number tells the programme how red it goes red, and which components need their declarations repaired (per #6939's shape) before strict can be switched on.」

## The population (measured, not inherited)

Source: PR objectui#11069, section M3. Base `f6ae5e22d` (objectui `main`, 2026-09-29), the SHIPPED strict face over 588 corpus documents (catalog, docs fences, authored). Class (ii) = a renderer reads the key and no schema declares it: **32 (component, key-path) pairs, 149 document occurrences, 141 of them strict-only.** The enumeration, copied from that section:

- `form` · `showSubmit` in 76 documents. `form.tsx` destructures `showSubmit` from `schema`. All 76 are catalog `fields-*` fixtures.
- `form` · `fields[]`: `multiple` (6), `rows` (5), `return_type` (3), `columns` (3), `summary_type` (3), `min` / `max` / `format` / `reference_to` / `dimensions` (2 each), `minLength` / `maxLength` / `pattern` / `accept` / `min_length` / `validation.message` (1 each). Each has a named read in `@object-ui/fields` widgets or in `form.tsx`.
- `dashboard` · `widgets[].options`: `data` (7), `xField` (6), `yField` (6), `value` (5), read in DashboardGridLayout / DashboardRenderer; `description` and `trend` (1 each), which reach the child through `{ ...widget, ...options }`. And `widgets[].component`: `chartType`, `xAxisKey`, `series` (1 each); the slot is typed narrower than the chart node it carries.
- `dataSource` on `object-grid` (2), `list-view` (2), `object-form` (1) and `object-kanban` (1). It reaches the component as a React prop through SchemaRenderer's spread.
- `page` · `regions[].children` (1) and `page:tabs` · `items` (1).

**The seat's spot-check of the largest pair** (objectui `origin/main` `480de81`, 2026-09-29T08:49Z):
- `packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx:1189` reads `showSubmit = true`, and `:3406` renders the submit button on `{showSubmit && (`.
- `showSubmit` has 0 hits in `packages/types/src/form.ts` and `packages/types/src/zod/form.zod.ts`. Control, same files: `submitLabel` is declared at `form.ts:1962` and `form.zod.ts:991`.
- 77 files under `examples/schema-catalog` carry `"showSubmit"`.

## Direction (for triage and the owning seat, ⛔ not a ruling)

- For each pair: declare it on both faces (TS and the zod mirror) when authors write it and a renderer reads it. When it is a host-supplied prop, rule it runtime-only and correct the documents that author it. `dataSource` reaching components through the renderer's prop spread is the obvious candidate for that second route. Existing rulings bind and are read before any declaration: the 2026-08-18 host-composition ruling (#5097) and the grid non-author keys (#5091, pinned by `plugin-grid/src/__tests__/gridNonAuthorKeys.test.tsx`).
- ⛔ Not a `.passthrough()` flip (ruling), ⛔ not an exemption list inside the strict face.
- **Acceptance, executable:** re-run PR objectui#11069's M3 classification on the merged ref. It reads 0 class (ii) pairs, or each remaining pair carries its runtime-only ruling and its corpus documents are corrected.
- The class (iii) half (a key the TypeScript type declares and the zod mirror omits: 10 pairs in the same M3) is objectui#6152's `UnmirroredDeclared` ledger, ⛔ not this card.

## Dedupe

The 1000 most recently updated objectui items (issues and PRs, open and closed), listed over REST and grepped locally, read 2026-09-29T08:50Z:
- `showSubmit`: 1 hit (objectui#6033, closed, an earlier mirror-drift round).
- `read … undeclared`: 6 hits. objectui#8347 (the TS index signature), objectui#8649 (plugin-detail reads, `pm:on-hold`, other components), and objectui#7928, #10547, #8885, #7531 (other components, all closed).
- `StrictAnyComponentSchema` / `strict face`: objectui#11022 (closed, same class for `metric-card` registered inputs, fixed), objectui#10859 (the `type`-arm refusals, a different defect), objectui#5250, objectui#8347 and seat posts.
- Control: `passthrough` 25 hits.
